description.value: Chosun Korean BBQ is a sit-down Korean restaurant in Vancouver's West End offering traditional Korean dishes alongside online ordering for takeout. The menu highlights items like Padak Chicken, Sweet Pig Trotters, Mussel Soup, and Cheese Kimchi Rice, aiming for an authentic Korean experience in a relaxed, cozy setting. A touring cyclist arriving on Davie Street would find a full-service restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 32m; stands (2 spaces) at 37m; stands (5 spaces) at 50m. Total: 9 spaces.
